sources: Mi Fu (batch 4; report docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0031_mifu.md, its Mechanics rows and § Kit). Hits, frames, keys, poise, finisher factors, physical statuses, energy, SP and team energy from rmxlinux Json/SkillData chr_0031_mifu_* as efsim kit-draft compiles them (2026-10-21), values from SkillPatchTable at the build's skill level, potentials and talents from PotentialTalentEffectTable (skillBbModifier: P1 combo potential / extra_effect / extra_time, P3 combo potential / talent_shield_cd / potential_addattack_*, P5 the three moves' atk_scale(2) ×1.1 and the ultimate's poise2 +5; talent 1 normalskill_3 talent / crushmultiadd_talent 0.1 / 0.2; talent 2 combo talent / talent_shield_*).

Battle-skill states (ChangeSkillAction in Json/BuffData buff_chr_0031_mifu_normalskill_2 / _3, 15 s, lifeTimeType 2: the battle-skill button becomes Trail and Mangle / World Splitter): kit buffs trail_ready and splitter_ready gate the three moves through `available`; each state's start ends the other (buffEvent 0 FinishBuff); the finisher pauses them (buff_chr_0031_mifu_buffpause, abilityEvent 9 / 203 PauseBuffTime).

Not modelled: Trail and Mangle's ×1.25 self speed-up over its first 15 frames (TimeDilationAction layer 1 on herself: Ti1b, open; everything after its frame 15 comes 3 frames late); the ultimate's literal-0 DamageAction at f98 (left out by the compiler, D8c); talent 2's shield and super armor (no damage effect; operator HP isn't tracked, N2); pulls, teleports (buff_chr_0031_mifu_comboprocess), hit-stop switches and World Splitter's CheckSuperArmor hit-stop choice. BuffData buff_chr_0031_mifu_passive, _passive_2, _passive_detect, _blue, _red, _test_1, _anglevalue, _WoundBuff, _vulnerablephysic_ultimate and _chrdg_* are created by no file: leftovers. The dive attack (plunging_attack_end) is in the kit but castable only once dives are rotation steps (batch-1 S10).

buffs.label: Battle skill is Trail and Mangle
buffs.note: BuffData buff_chr_0031_mifu_normalskill_2: duration 15 (a literal: useBlackboardKey false), stackingType 2 max 1; buffEvent 5 ChangeSkillAction normalskill_1 → normalskill_2. Created by Cloudtrapper (f0), the combo (f27) and the ultimate (f102); its start ends World Splitter's state (trigger trail_replaces_splitter); Trail and Mangle ends it at its f24 (trail_end); the finisher pauses it (finisher_pause_trail).

buffs.label: Battle skill is World Splitter
buffs.note: BuffData buff_chr_0031_mifu_normalskill_3: duration 15 (literal), ChangeSkillAction → normalskill_3. Created by buff_chr_0031_mifu_listen_crush (Trail and Mangle f22–27) on a Crush (abilityEvent 401, CheckPhysicalInflictionType mask 8) from a battle skill (CheckOriginSkillType [2]) on a target with at least 3 Vulnerable stacks (tag 1075718177): Trail and Mangle's mangle_splitter hit. Its start ends Trail and Mangle's state; World Splitter ends it at its f21 (splitter_end).

buffs.label: Combo: Physical Susceptibility
buffs.note: Combo f31 (before its DamageAction): ModifyDynamicBlackboard final_effect = rate (+ extra_effect if potential = 1), final_time = duration (+ extra_time), then CreateBuff buff_chr_0031_mifu_vulnerablephysic_comboskill on the target (VulnerableAction subType 2: buff_common_affixes_vulnerable_physical, as Estella's). extra_effect and extra_time are 0 (SkillData defaults) until P1 sets them and potential = 1, so the sums are exact: 5% for 16 s at level 12, 10% for 20 s at P1+. Whether it adds to another source's Physical Susceptibility: in-game test 38.

buffs.label: P3: ATK when the shield triggers
buffs.note: BuffData buff_chr_0031_mifu_potential_addattack: attribute 2 (ATK) formulaItem 6 addattack_effect, duration addattack_duraion; the combo assigns potential_addattack_effect (0.06 from P3) and potential_addattack_duration (20 s from P3). Below P3 both keys are 0 (SkillData defaults): the P1 `potential` flag alone would create it with no effect.

triggers.note: COMBO TRIGGER (CharGrowthTable text): "When an enemy has 3 or more Vulnerability stacks" (the condition is game code). The engine opens a 6 s window per Vulnerable event at 3+ stacks (a stack added at the cap counts: in-game test 64). Whether the game treats it as a state (relit when the cooldown ends while 3+ stacks remain, dark once a Crush consumes them): in-game test 90 (batch-3 T5).

normalskill_1 f0: ObtainCostAction costType 1, a literal 50 (atbGainMethod 1: returned SP, the literal's default kind; "returns 50 SP after casting"), and CreateBuff buff_chr_0031_mifu_normalskill_2. kit-draft emits the SP; the state is hand-written (D10a reports it, nothing compiled).
normalskill_2 f24 FinishBuffAction buff_chr_0031_mifu_normalskill_2 (the cast's own: a cast cut before f24 keeps the state).
normalskill_3 f21 FinishBuffAdvanced buff_chr_0031_mifu_normalskill_3 (a cast cut before f21 keeps the state).
combo_skill f27 CreateBuff buff_chr_0031_mifu_normalskill_2 (ends a World Splitter state).

ultimate_skill f102 CreateBuff buff_chr_0031_mifu_normalskill_2. Its buffpause (0–105, autoFinishByAction) is moot: the cast can't be cut before f103 (ChannelingCastingAction 0–103) and f102 applies the state fresh, which also ends World Splitter's.

powerattack CreateBuff buff_chr_0031_mifu_buffpause at f0 (autoFinishByAction) and buff_common_power_attack_disable_cast_skill 0–38 (the channel that holds the finisher): the state buffs' abilityEvent 9 / 203 handlers pause their time while buffpause is on. Written as Purrchena's pause: 38 frames more on the active state (exact unless the finisher is cut before f38, which its channel doesn't allow).
As finisher_pause_trail, for World Splitter's state.

combo_skill f0: if talent > 0 (talent 2 Vigilant Fury sets it) and CheckGlobalCDTimer(buff_chr_0031_mifu_shield): the shield (talent_shield_hppercent of Max HP, talent_shield_duration; no damage effect) and, if potential > 0, buff_chr_0031_mifu_potential_addattack; AddGlobalCDTimer talent_shield_cd (60 s, 45 s at P3). potentialAtLeast 3: P1 also sets potential = 1, but the buff's values are 0 below P3 (see p3_atk).
